labels.notes: Lean >= target. Causal.Flat.spaceCylinder_separates (FlatSpaceCylinder.lean:419) is a closed statement with no hypothesis and no instance argument. It holds every conjunct the target names (T2Space, SecondCountableTopology, ConnectedSpace of SpaceCylinder, the seven provides, and the negation of FutureOneConnected) plus the twelve other causality-sort nodes and, for every W, AbsolutelyMinimalOn W. Each conjunct was re-elaborated against the fully qualified ladder `lean` names (Causal.Causality.GloballyHyperbolic, .PushUp, .CausallyOpen, Causal.Precausality.AbsolutelyMinimal of spaceCylinder.toPrecausality, .CausallyArcConnected, .CausallyPlain, .ChronalNeighbours, .CausallyCompact, .CausallyOpenFuture, .CurvesExtend, .HasChronalNeighbourEverywhere, .IsCausal, .LocallyCausallyOpen, .LocallyCausallyOpenFuture, .LocallyPushUp, .StronglyCausal, .StronglyCausalOpen, .Tarentin, .HasTimeFunction, Causal.Precausality.AbsolutelyMinimalOn, Causal.Causality.FutureOneConnected). The term `spaceCylinder_separates` closes that statement. The model was checked by rfl: SpaceCylinder = MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (FlatQuotient.spaceGroup 0) (⊤ : Opens (Minkowski 1)); spaceCylinder = flatCausality 1 SpaceCylinder; spaceGroup 0 = (spaceTranslation 0).range; spaceTranslation 0 n • p = n • spaceVec 0 + p; spaceVec 0 = (0, EuclideanSpace.single 0 1). The group is therefore the spacelike ℤe₁ (time component 0), not the timelike ℤe₀ of timeCylinder. Minkowski 1 = ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) is 1+1-dimensional, and the generator has Euclidean length 1. flatCausality (IsomCausal.lean:440) is the library's unique absolutely minimal causality whose charts are isomorphisms onto minkowski d, as for the time cylinder. GH: the hfin hypothesis of FlatQuotient.globallyHyperbolic_quotient (Examples.lean:396; #check: ∀ x y : Ω, {γ | (flatCausality d Ω).le ⊤ x (γ • y)}.Finite) is literally the statement of finite_le_spaceGroup at d = 1, Ω = ⊤, Γ = spaceGroup 0. Its proof is the evidence's bound: from x ≤ y + n e₁, the e₁ coordinate gives |n + y₁ − x₁| ≤ y₀ − x₀, so |n| ≤ ⌈|y₁ − x₁| + (y₀ − x₀)⌉. The winding argument is in the target sub-claim /4-winding. (a) The bridge ChronalHomotopyOn.homotopicRel (:124) defines a ContinuousMap.HomotopyRel f₀ f₁ {0,1} by (t, s) ↦ Γ t s on I × I, with mathlib's convention (first coordinate the homotopy parameter): map_zero_left from eqOn_zero, map_one_left from eqOn_one, prop' (s ∈ {0,1} gives F(t,s) = f₀ s) from fix_zero/fix_one. Continuity comes from ContinuousOn (uncurry Γ) (Icc 0 1 ×ˢ Icc 0 1) composed with the inclusion I × I → Icc ×ˢ Icc, and the restriction to Icc is carried by hf₀/hf₁ (f = γ on I). Correct. (b) liftPath_apply_one_eq_of_homotopicRel is applied with cov = isCoveringMap_proj (spaceGroup 0) ⊤ and e = ⟨0, trivial⟩, with h0 k : f k 0 = proj ⟨0, trivial⟩. The lifts are identified with L k = s ↦ ⟨windLift k s, trivial⟩ by eq_liftPath_iff' (proj ∘ L k = f k by rfl, L k 0 = ⟨0, trivial⟩), so they end at (3, m e₁) and (3, n e₁), and the e₁ coordinate forces m = n. Correct. (c) windCurve_chronalCurveOn (:351) states spaceCylinder.ChronalCurveOn ⊤ (windCurve k) 0 1, exactly the curve hypothesis of FutureOneConnectedOn ⊤. The proof: windLift_lt shows ‖Δx‖ = (s'−s)|k| < 3(s'−s) = Δt (minkowski_lt_top_iff), minkowski_chronalCurveOn_iff makes the lift a chronal curve of minkowski 1, and the new IsEMorphismOn.chronalCurveOn_comp pushes it forward by isEMorphism_spaceCylinderMk (proj ∘ the identity into ⊤, a local isometry; flatCausality_self). (d) spaceCylinder_not_futureOneConnected (:399) applies hfoc to γ₀ = windCurve 0 and γ₁ = windCurve 1, with common endpoints [(0,0)] and [(3,0)] (windCurve_zero, windCurve_one_int), and refutes it with windCurve_not_chronallyHomotopicOn at W = ⊤. The definition used is Causal.Causality.FutureOneConnected = FutureOneConnectedOn ⊤ (TimelikeHomotopy.lean). Non-vacuity: ChronallyHomotopicOn is satisfiable in the library (ChronallyHomotopicOn.refl, timelikeLine_futureOneConnectedOn, Minkowski's FOC), and the negation rests on covering-space theory, not on a defect of the definition. Marks: no ETT label is marked. The five bold marks are the target's own sub-ids (/1-topology … /5-separation), following the strict-library precedent Causal/Model/FlatTimeCylinder.lean:19–35, and each names fully proved declarations with no sorry. One imprecision, not a finding: in spaceCylinder_separates the `by causal_ladder` for Tarentin closes from h8 := spaceCylinder_tarentin (the SFA bundle), not from the seven alone. The closure of the seven containing tarentin is a ladder fact, confirmed by the simulation (has = the 19 nodes).
